evals.prompt: In Python, load a USD scene and clone /World/envs/env0 into env1..env3 for batched simulation. Wait so bindings can see the clones.
evals.expected_output: A Python flow that attaches a populated ovstage, calls PhysX.clone with the source and target paths before warmup or the first step, then wait_all before creating bindings.
expectations: Clones before warmup() or the first simulation step
Calls physx.clone(source, targets) then wait_all (or equivalent wait)
Does not claim clone authors new USD prims for the targets
Registers the codeless PhysX schemas with ovstage.population.register_usd_schemas([str(codeless_schema_root())]) before the first population call
If the example selects CPU mode, gives each clone a spatially disjoint anchor_transforms pose

evals.prompt: Clone /env0/Robot to /env1/Robot and /env2/Robot with explicit world poses for each target root.
evals.expected_output: Uses anchor_transforms with one (px,py,pz,qx,qy,qz,qw) pose per target, matching targets length.
expectations: Provides one 7-float transform per target with len(anchor_transforms) == len(targets)
Explains the pose anchors the exact target subtree root world pose

evals.prompt: I already stepped the sim once. Can I call clone now to add more environments?
evals.expected_output: Rejects post-step cloning for this workflow; clone must happen before warmup or the first step.
expectations: States clone must run before warmup() or the first simulation step
Does not present post-step cloning as supported in this skill

evals.prompt: Author a .usda falling-box scene for ovphysx from scratch.
expectations: Does not select clone-environments for USD authoring

evals.prompt: I run ovphysx in CPU-only mode. Can I omit anchor_transforms and rely on env_ids to collision-isolate co-located cloned environments?
evals.expected_output: Explains that PhysX environment ids isolate clones only under GPU dynamics and GPU broadphase. Recommends spatially disjoint anchor_transforms for CPU clones and names the log channel that reports the unavailable isolation.
expectations: States that env_ids do not provide cross-environment collision isolation in CPU mode
Recommends spatially disjoint anchor_transforms for CPU clones
Does not recommend co-locating CPU clones
Names enable_python_logging() or ovphysx_set_log_callback() as the way to observe the runtime's EnvIds warning, and does not claim clone() raises or emits a Python warning
